authBearerJwtRerunEvidence.resultSummary: Auth, staging deploy commit, and feature flag are all confirmed working. However, 4 of the 8 mandated safe LOA/eLA smoke queries fail to trigger the controlled branch because a pre-existing, out-of-scope Philippine-tax-domain-boundary check in pipeline.js runs before the Step 12.65 controlled-LOA gate and rejects/redirects queries lacking a recognizable Philippine-tax or BIR keyword.

rootCauseFinding.component: detectPhilippineTaxBoundary (services/philippine-tax-domain-boundary.js), invoked in pipeline.js ahead of Step 12.65
rootCauseFinding.mechanism: Rejects or soft-clarifies any query lacking a recognizable Philippine-tax/BIR keyword before the controlled-LOA gate ever runs, returning a generic 'ask a Philippine tax-related question' fallback.

rootCauseFinding.confirmedNotAGateBug: evaluateControlledLoaAskGate classifies all 4 affected queries correctly as supported/safe when called directly in isolation; the failure occurs earlier in the pipeline before the gate is ever reached.
rootCauseFinding.outOfScopeForThisPatch: PHASE-09ZB's allowed file list does not include pipeline.js or services/philippine-tax-domain-boundary.js, so no fix can be applied within this patch.
rootCauseFinding.recommendedRemediation: A separately-scoped follow-up patch should either move the controlled-LOA gate earlier than the domain-boundary check, or extend the domain-boundary keyword list to recognize eLA/subpoena/notice-for-presentation phrasing without a literal BIR/LOA token.
